name: Medical-Whisper-Large-v3
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from openai/whisper-large-v3 (config.json max_position_embeddings 1500). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
notes: ADDED 2026-10-27. A finetune of openai/whisper-large-v3, not a new base model: same config.json, same 1.543 parameters (identical tensor set). Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2024-07-18. Evidence caveat: WER/CER are printed as fractions (0.19/0.10) and stored as printed; the card is auto-generated by Trainer, states no normaliser, harness or test-set identity, and adds a separate test-set row (0.24 WER) with no base column.

benchmarks.name: Validation WER (fraction as printed; 0.19 = 19%)
benchmarks.config: Card 'Performance Overview' table: 'Whisper Medical' 0.19 vs 'Whisper Large v3' 0.33, same validation set, 1.55B params both. Self-reported, no normaliser or harness stated; the model card is auto-generated by Trainer and the paper the eval protocol comes from is not cited.
